summary: Plan workplace change, support team adoption and track progress with practical diagnostics and action tools. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Adaptability strategy training helps team leads, HR practitioners and operational specialists plan workplace transitions alongside ongoing work. You’ll assess readiness and change impacts, use ADKAR prompts to plan individual support, and track adoption with feedback and scorecard measures. Exercises also cover capacity planning and sequencing actions so teams can respond to change while maintaining service delivery.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits people who coordinate workplace transitions, support affected teams or report on adoption. It is designed for professionals who need practical tools for guiding change alongside ongoing work.
modules: Bridges Transition Model in Daily Work
prerequisites: Experience working in a team affected by process, role or technology changes will help you apply the exercises. No specialist change-management experience is assumed.
